sentence_stem: If I had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: I would be working in a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder last year, I would be working in a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I would have a better job today.
I would be happier at work now.

options.text: I would be working in a better job now.

options.why_wrong: This talks about the future and does not show the present result of a past condition.

options.text: I worked in a better job last year.
options.why_wrong: This describes the past and does not show the present result of the condition in the stem.
This repeats the condition instead of giving the result, so the sentence is incomplete.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditional: past perfect in the if-clause, would plus a present result
explanation: A mixed conditional links a past condition with a present result. The if-clause uses the past perfect, and the result clause uses would with a present time expression. Learners whose first language uses a single tense for both times may need extra practice with this pattern.
translation: Si hubiera estudiado más el año pasado, ahora trabajaría en un mejor empleo.
